name: SOURCERUNE SCENE PRESET HERO 049-074 Production V1
rule: Each scene is authored as an independent single image asset. Atlas output is reference-only and must never replace individual files.

direction: practical lighting; restrained warm/cool filmic grade
environment context is at least as important as the emitter/person

template.cropPolicy: Generate one clean photographic master composition with safe margins, then create each target crop independently; do not resize/crop an atlas tile.

scenes.name: Flat TV - Living Room
scenes.brief: Modern flat-screen television as the audible source in a believable living room; medium-wide room composition, TV glow, sofa/table cues, practical warm lamp light, broadcast/talk-program feel rather than product glamour.

scenes.name: Baby Monitor - Bedroom
scenes.brief: Baby monitor clearly identifiable in a real bedroom/nursery; crib and domestic room context, intimate low-light practical lighting, device is part of scene rather than isolated product shot.

scenes.name: Voice Approaches - Hallway
scenes.brief: Person at the far-to-mid end of a realistic hallway walking toward listener/camera; corridor perspective is dominant, person medium-small, direct voice situation.

scenes.name: Voice Walks Past - Quiet Street
scenes.brief: Person walking laterally past listener on a quiet street; medium-wide sidewalk/street composition, restrained motion cue, night/dusk practical street light, not fashion photography.

scenes.name: Voice Leaves - Down Corridor
scenes.brief: Person walking away down a corridor; back turned, strong recession/vanishing lines, environment larger than subject.

scenes.name: Train PA Approaches - Platform
scenes.brief: Train approaching platform with public-address context visible or implied; platform geometry and train approach direction must read immediately.

scenes.name: Train PA Pass By - Platform
scenes.brief: Train passing a platform laterally; believable transport scene, modest natural motion blur, PA/public-transport context, not action-poster styling.

scenes.name: Subway Announcement - Pull Away
scenes.brief: Subway train pulling away from platform; rear/side departure direction clearly readable, realistic station environment.

scenes.name: Bullhorn Marcher Approaches
scenes.brief: Marcher/speaker approaching with handheld bullhorn; observational documentary framing, modest crowd context, megaphone readable but not heroic poster composition.

scenes.name: Portable PA Pass By - Courtyard
scenes.brief: Portable PA speaker moving through an architectural courtyard, carried or wheeled by a person; environment and moving emitter both readable.

scenes.name: Car Radio Through Window - Pass By
scenes.brief: Car passing listener with audible radio behind a closed side window; car motion and closed-window barrier both visually readable.

scenes.name: Phone In Backpack - Walk By Concourse
scenes.brief: Person walking through station concourse with phone inside backpack; backpack is readable, concourse movement and crowd/architecture context visible.

scenes.name: Bus PA Pull Away - Bus Stop
scenes.brief: Bus pulling away from a stop with onboard PA context; departure direction readable, bus-stop environment visible.

scenes.name: Car Door Speaker Approaches - Parking Lot
scenes.brief: Car approaching in parking lot with door-speaker source context; front/three-quarter approach, parking-lot geometry, realistic night/evening lighting.

scenes.name: ADR Match - Small Office
scenes.brief: ADR voice placed into a small office; one person/dialogue perspective in modest office, desk/glass/office cues, neutral production-realism.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Bathroom
scenes.brief: Direct speaking voice in hard reflective bathroom; person plus tile/mirror/sink cues, small-room reflections visually implied.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Stairwell
scenes.brief: Direct voice in stairwell; person in concrete/painted stairwell, vertical geometry and hard reflections dominant.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Warehouse
scenes.brief: Direct voice in warehouse; person small-to-medium within large industrial interior, depth, steel/concrete, long-space perspective.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Tunnel / Underpass
scenes.brief: Direct voice in tunnel or underpass; person within long hard reflective passage, strong depth and practical lamps.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Open Field
scenes.brief: Direct voice in open field; person in broad minimally reflective landscape, horizon/sky/grass, simple natural daylight/dusk.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Forest
scenes.brief: Direct voice in forest; person among trees, irregular natural absorption/scattering feel, grounded documentary realism.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Canyon
scenes.brief: Direct voice in canyon; person small against canyon walls/rock, long outdoor reflection potential, natural scale emphasized.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Beach
scenes.brief: Direct voice at beach; person near open shoreline, water/horizon/wind context, broad minimally enclosed environment.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Sedan Interior
scenes.brief: Direct voice inside sedan; person seated in realistic car cabin, dashboard/window/interior cues, compact enclosed acoustic context.

scenes.name: Direct Voice - Airplane Cabin
scenes.brief: Direct voice inside airplane cabin; seated passenger/crew context, rows/windows/overhead panels, realistic commercial aircraft interior.

scenes.name: Voice Behind Concrete Wall
scenes.brief: Voice behind concrete wall; two-space barrier story or visible heavy concrete partition, person/source clearly separated from listener side by high-mass wall.
